svg.title: From interview footage to a themed clip
svg.desc: A real editing case. The source covers career path, job qualities and a work case. The Agent builds the clip from the career path and an occupational sleep study, fixes a content gap and an overrun, then uses media tools to render a 48-second vertical clip with subtitles.
svg.text: From interview footage to a themed clip
Career path, job qualities, research case
Study of working hours and sleep
First cut listed job qualities, not the actual work. Research case added,
selections trimmed to length, clip rendered after passing review.
Transcription: faster-whisper, review: independent model, rendering: FFmpeg
